questions.stem: Earth has a MAGNETIC FIELD because of:
questions.explanation: Earth's magnetic field generated by GEODYNAMO — convection in MOLTEN OUTER CORE (liquid iron + nickel). Self-sustaining electromagnetic process. PROTECTS Earth from solar wind / cosmic rays — without it, atmosphere would be stripped (Mars lost its magnetic field 4 BYA → atmosphere blown away → cold + dry today). MAGNETIC POLES drift; OCCASIONALLY reverse (geomagnetic reversal, every ~hundreds of thousands of years). Field strength ~25-65 microtesla. Compass N-pole points to MAGNETIC NORTH (which is geomagnetic SOUTH due to naming convention).

questions.explanation: ELECTROMAGNET = solenoid (coil) wound on soft iron core; magnetic field exists only when CURRENT flows. Discovered by ØRSTED (1820). ADVANTAGES: (1) STRENGTH ADJUSTABLE; (2) ON/OFF switchable; (3) Much STRONGER than permanent magnets achievable. USES: motors, transformers, MRI, doorbells, relays, maglev trains, scrapyard cranes, particle accelerators. AMPERE'S RIGHT-HAND RULE: curl fingers in current direction → thumb points to N pole. FARADAY'S LAW (1831): changing magnetic flux induces EMF (foundation of generators). MAXWELL unified all in 4 equations (1860s).

questions.explanation: FARADAY'S LAW (1831) — changing magnetic flux induces EMF. Foundation of GENERATORS, TRANSFORMERS, MOTORS, MRI, induction cooktops, wireless chargers. EMF = -dΦ/dt; Lenz's law: induced current opposes change. JOSEPH HENRY (American) discovered induction independently around same time. Faraday also discovered: BENZENE structure, electrolysis laws (1834). MOTORS reverse the principle (current in field → force/rotation). HUGE PRACTICAL impact: India's 400 GW power grid relies entirely on Faraday's discovery (turbines spin → AC generators → transformers step up/down).

questions.explanation: MAGLEV — train floats above tracks via magnetic repulsion / attraction. NO friction → very fast + smooth. Speeds: 400-600+ km/h. EXAMPLES: Shanghai Maglev (China, 431 km/h commercial); SCMaglev (Japan, world record 603 km/h test). VS BULLET TRAINS (Shinkansen, French TGV) — those use steel wheels + rails. INDIA: Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train (Shinkansen-tech, ~320 km/h target) under construction; Vande Bharat (160 km/h) running. MAGLEV = expensive but minimal maintenance (no wheel wear). HYPERLOOP (Elon Musk concept) — vacuum tube + maglev → ~1000 km/h (proposed Mumbai-Pune; status uncertain).

questions.stem: MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) for medical scanning works by:

options.option_text: Hydrogen nuclei aligning + flipping in magnetic field
X-rays scanning the patient body too alone
Ultrasonic sound waves bouncing off alone

questions.explanation: MRI — Strong magnetic field (1.5-7 T) aligns HYDROGEN nuclei in body's water; radio pulses flip them; signals during return reveal tissue type. NO IONISING RADIATION (safer than X-ray, CT). Best for SOFT TISSUES (brain, spinal cord, joints, organs). Limitation: people with metal implants (pacemakers, certain stents) can't get MRI. Inventors of clinical MRI: Lauterbur + Mansfield (Nobel 2003). Compare: X-RAY (electromagnetic, bones); CT (multiple X-rays, 3D); ULTRASOUND (sound, fetus + soft); PET (radioactive tracer); ECG (heart); EEG (brain).

questions.stem: A COMPASS works because Earth has:
questions.explanation: COMPASS NEEDLE = small magnet aligning with Earth's field → points ~N-S. INVENTED in CHINA ~11th century (lodestone — natural magnet, magnetite). Revolutionised SEA NAVIGATION + global trade. MAGNETIC NORTH ≠ TRUE NORTH; difference = MAGNETIC DECLINATION (varies geographically + over decades). Currently magnetic N pole near 86°N in Arctic, drifting toward Russia at ~50 km/year! Modern GPS replaced compass for navigation, but compass remains BACKUP (no battery, works always; used by hikers, ships, aircraft). GYRO compass — used in ships, points to TRUE north regardless of magnetic field.

questions.stem: Cutting a bar magnet in half results in:

options.option_text: Two smaller magnets, each with N + S poles
One N-pole magnet + one S-pole only

questions.explanation: MAGNETIC MONOPOLES DON'T EXIST (in classical physics). Each piece retains BOTH poles, no matter how small. FUNDAMENTAL: ∇·B = 0 (one of Maxwell's 4 equations). DIRAC predicted theoretical monopoles (1931); searched but never confirmed. CONTRAST: ELECTRIC charges exist as monopoles (electrons, protons isolated). PRACTICAL: scatter iron filings near magnet → each tiny filing acts as mini-magnet; reveal field-line patterns (school experiment). Even atomic dipoles in ferromagnets (iron, nickel, cobalt, neodymium) have both poles. Modern strong magnets (NdFeB) ~1 T strength.
